THEY HAVE AN ESSAY/PAPER WEBSITE. This is the first review I’ve ever written but I have to say I’m impressed. Im not sure how to write a review on their essay website so I am going to do it here. 
It is currently 2:20 AM, I decided I did not need their subscription for 400k+ essays (and they literally mean over 400k) not because it was bad but because I’m not going to school anymore. It helped me write an entrance essay in 1 hour for a nursing program when I was having literal writers block for a month. 
The reason why I am so impressed is because of their customer service. I needed to cancel my subscription and the only way to do that was by emailing their support team. I got nervous when it said they would respond in no more than 12 hours but sent the email at 1:50 am anyway. I kid you not, I received a response within 20 minutes with my subscription canceled and a, short & sweet “thank you for your time.” 
I’m impressed. There was no delay, it was very timely, convenient, and very easy to do. There was also no one trying to convince me to stay subscribed to their site. 
When I decide to go back to school, you better bet I will be resubscribed in an instant. 
Thank you!
